summary: A single list of books with fields for title, author, and category. Lend a book by setting a borrower; clear the borrower when it comes back. Filter to see what is out and how many are lent.
implemented_features: Add a book and see it in the list
Delete a book added by mistake
Lend a book and show the borrower
Return a book and clear the borrower
Filter to see only books that are lent out
Filter to see only books that are at home
See how many books are lent out right now
Persist data across a browser refresh
assumptions: The category select uses the three kinds the user named: Novel, Cookbook, Reference.
A book with no Borrower is considered at home; a book with a Borrower is lent out.
The headline stat is the count of books currently lent out.
Omitted due dates or overdue tracking: The idea does not mention when books are due back.
Omitted multiple copies or quantities per title: The idea treats each book as a single item.
Omitted user accounts or sharing: The idea states it is just one person on their own computer.
Omitted shelf location or cover images: The idea does not mention where a book sits or what it looks like.
Search and alphabetical sorting are provided by the scaffold and are always available.
